ns2:course.label: Actuarial Problem Solving
ns2:course.description: Methods and techniques of solving problems in actuarial mathematics for advanced students intending to enter the actuarial profession. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in the same or subsequent semesters to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
